name: Bloom Into Frost
source:
A young woman travels with her best friend to meet her grandmother for the first time. In a town built in the shadow of a god's corpse, she finds truths about her mother, and maybe a new love.

[From [url=https://halfbrick.itch.io/bloom-into-frost]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位年轻女子与她最好的朋友一起旅行，第一次见到她的祖母。在一座建在神的尸体阴影下的小镇里，她找到了关于她母亲的真相，也许还找到了新的爱情。

[来自[url=https://halfbrick.itch.io/bloom-into-frost]itch.io[/url]]
